preconditions.description: The number of queries is between 1 and 15000, inclusive.
The number of vertices in each tree is between 2 and 300000, inclusive.
The vertices of each edge are between 1 and n, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The sum of all n does not exceed 300000
preconditions.description: The sum of all numbers of vertices in all trees does not exceed 300000.

postconditions.description: The maximum size of a good subtree for each query is between 1 and the number of vertices in the tree, inclusive.
